name: Bloodtalon Matriarch
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
narrative.objectives: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, Ashogg. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
